h1.cap: Why does the loudest person in the room... get the credit?

n2.cap: Two new hires. Dan talks big in every meeting.

n3.cap: Aisha quietly fixes the problems nobody sees.

n4.cap: Six months later... Dan gets promoted.

n5.cap: Unfair? Machiavelli saw this coming... over 500 years ago.

q1.cap: He wrote... "men judge generally more by the eye than by the hand."

n6.cap: The eye is how you look. The hand is what people find up close... and few get that close.

q2.cap: "Everyone sees what you appear to be, few really know what you are."

n7.cap: He meant it as advice to rulers... you don't need every virtue... just seem to have them.

n8.cap: Don't copy the mask. Flip the lesson. Judge people by the hand... what they do, not what they promise.

n9.cap: And if you're Aisha... hidden work can't speak for you. Let the eye see it.

n10.cap: Tonight, send your team one short note... three things you finished this month.

n11.cap: Ever been an Aisha? Tell me in the comments.

n12.cap: Follow Awazzzz... and let your real work be seen.
